verses.display_text: As for the dead being raised, have you not read in the book of Moses, in the passage about the bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham and the God of Isaac and the God of Jacob’?

verses.display_text: He is not God of the dead, but of the living. You are greatly mistaken.”

verses.display_text: One of the scribes approached, having heard them disputing and seen that He had answered them well. He asked Him, “Which commandment is first of all?”

verses.display_text: Jesus answered, “The first is, ‘Hear, Israel: the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

verses.display_text: The second is this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

verses.display_text: The scribe said to Him, “Well said, Teacher! Thou hast truly said that He is one, and there is no other besides Him.

verses.display_text: To love Him with the whole heart, with the whole understanding, and with the whole strength, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, is more than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

verses.display_text: Seeing that he answered thoughtfully, Jesus said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” No one dared to question Him any further.

verses.display_text: David himself calls Him Lord; how then is He his son?” The large crowd listened to Him gladly.

verses.display_text: They devour widows’ houses and make long prayers as a pretense. These will receive greater judgment.”

verses.display_text: And one poor widow came and put in two lepta, which make a quadrans.

verses.display_text: For they all put in from their surplus, but she, from her need, put in everything she had—her whole livelihood.”

verses.display_text: As He was leaving the temple, one of His disciples said to Him, “Teacher, look! What stones and what buildings!”

verses.display_text: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? Not one stone will be left here on another that will not be torn down.”
